# Innovative technologies

**Remedy Technologies** is an innovative **MedTech startup** focused on the research and development of new materials and technological solutions for the **treatment of oncological spinal diseases** and for **real-time tissue monitoring** during neurosurgeries.

[Discover more](https://remedytechnologies.eu/)

![](https://remedytechnologies.eu/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/shutterstock_1406696738-min.jpg)

#### Our vision

## Our vision is to improve patients’ quality of life by introducing innovative technologies to make surgeries simpler, safer and more effective.

### **Innovation**

Remedy Technologies’ innovation lies in developing MedTech devices using advanced technologies to optimize the clinical outcome.

### **Simplicity**

Instruments and medical devices are designed to simplify surgical practice and address surgeons’ needs.

### Research

Research is at the heart of Remedy Technologies with 20 years experience in biomedical and materials science fields.

## **Would you like to receive more information?**

If you are interested in our projects, please contact us and we will be able to provide you with all the details.
